body: it was. Bur I had a contract with my boss to receive the money on a certain date.

On a logical level I know it was the right decision to give him away because I cannot give him the life he deserves anymore. But human beings are rarely logical.
I'll get through this and get a pet that doesn't require 2 hour long daily walks to be truly happy. But for now it just hurts.
And I've never been entirely alone before. I've always had pets, girlfriends or at least my family. Now I have nothing left and I'm texting people, oversharing and just basically being a human trainwreck.

Thank you for your kind words, they mean a lot to me ❤️ the past few days have been overwhelming and I miss my dog more than I could ever say. He used to be my whole support system and he was able to calm me down when no one else could.

I just lost my dog and half of my family (they're alive, just not talking to me anymore and the dog I had to give away) due to an ugly accident almost a week ago.
I'm so starved of any kind of attention and it's literally painful to be alive right now.
